info.title: dnt API
info.description: Projects, documentation, and work. Bearer tokens use /api/v1; IAM SigV4 uses the regional API Gateway AgentApi endpoint /agent/v1 with the same relative paths. IDs share one sequence across initiatives, epics, and tasks. Lists are paginated; no delete/reparent for documentation or hard delete for work items in v1.
